title: Sources: the White House's Office of the National Cyber Director is drafting an EO to establish a government-led incubator aimed at cybersecurity research (Bloomberg)
summary: Bloomberg: Sources: the White House's Office of the National Cyber Director is drafting an EO to establish a government-led incubator aimed at cybersecurity research — The Trump administration is weighing a plan to establish a government-led incubator aimed at investing in cybersecurity research …
